# <case> <answer> for manifest.txt beside this file. `unrepresentable`: the
# declared kind cannot hold the value in the driver's storage, as the Go
# reference driver answers (test/conformance/go/writerefusal.go). `refused`:
# the storage holds it and the writer refuses it. `wrote`: the end of a range.
i32_past_max      unrepresentable
i32_max           wrote
i32_past_min      unrepresentable
u32_negative      unrepresentable
u32_max           wrote
u32_past_max      unrepresentable
i64_past_max      unrepresentable
i64_max           wrote
u64_negative      unrepresentable
u64_max           wrote
u64_past_max      unrepresentable
u8_past_max       refused
u8_negative       unrepresentable
u8_max            wrote
arr_i32_past_max  unrepresentable
arr_i32_max       wrote
arr_u32_negative  unrepresentable
arr_u32_max       wrote

arr_u64_max       wrote
chan_i32_past_max unrepresentable
chan_i32_max      wrote

chan_u64_max      wrote
